name: Duel Love: Koisuru Otome wa Shouri no Megami
original_name: デュエルラブ 恋する乙女は勝利の女神
source:
You're a transfer student in a high school who discovers there's a secret fight club after becoming closer with your classmates. You can help them win the fights by cheering them and then helping them clean up by washing their bodies.

[Based on [url=http://ameerkitty.wordpress.com/2011/06/18/duel-love-rub-rub-rub/]Ameerkitty's post[/url]]
translation:
你是一名刚转入高中的女生。与同学们熟悉后，你发现校内存在秘密格斗社。你可以通过呐喊助威帮助他们赢下比赛，随后替他们清洗身体，协助善后。

[根据 [url=http://ameerkitty.wordpress.com/2011/06/18/duel-love-rub-rub-rub/]Ameerkitty的文章[/url]修改]
